Name: (AT) Asters Walls and Floors Megapack
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[center]A bunch of my existing wallpaper and flooring mods all bundled into one mod
I have a [url=https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart]kofi page[/url]﻿ if you'd like to fuel me with coffee or would like to commission some art[/center][u]

Additional information:[/u]
If you're already using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10400]Asters Big Interior Mod[/url] you don't need the main file because it's already included there, but you might want the optional files
Mods shown in the screenshot include my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10982]bathroom furniture[/url]﻿ and my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11043/]Krobus House Cosplay[/url].
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11956?tab=files&file_id=54211]Floor Coverings[/url], because I wanted to make an expansion pack for that but it'd be hard to find if I put it under the Big Interior Mod﻿, you can find the expansion pack under optional files.
I have a video on how to use the AT framework in-game at the end of this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9984]mod page[/url]﻿.

[u]Art Credits[/u]
[list]
[*]Narianka kindly gave me permission to recolor several of her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11896]Pastel Rainbow Wallpapers[/url]﻿
[/list]
